description: Create a memory draft. Only Persian (Farsi) memories are accepted. Do not create or publish memories in English or any other language. Ask the user for the real place/date; never invent them. Returns a draft_id that must be confirmed by the user before publish_memory.

memory_date.description: Jalali YYYY/MM/DD (or Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.
